json.justification: The electric meter's exact position is unclear. The wall near the gas meter and chimney (Photo 14) sits right beside a car parked on the gravel/concrete-strip driveway that runs along the house (Photos 9–11), so the 5 ft clearances from the driveway and gas meter are doubtful there. The narrow side yard with the meter by a window (Photo 2) is not documented well enough to confirm a spot meeting the ComEd 3 ft window gaps and driveway clearance.
